The food was absolutely delicious – fresh ingredients, beautiful presentation, and rich flavors. I especially enjoyed the grilled seafood, which was perfectly cooked. Every detail, from the lighting to the music, created a warm and relaxing dining experience. Pavilion is the perfect place for a romantic dinner or a gathering with friends. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for quality and class.Thank Mrs. Giang
